games.title: Prism Rain
games.description: Guide a mint shard through an accelerating storm of geometric prisms.
games.instructions: Move with WASD or arrow keys. Drag anywhere on the arena to steer. Survive until the timer clears.

games.title: Comet Slip
games.description: Pilot a tiny courier spark through drifting comets and wake trails.
games.instructions: Use WASD or arrows, or hold and drag to fly. Keep all shields intact until extraction.

games.title: Vector Veil
games.description: Dodge slicing vectors as the safe space contracts and shifts around you.
games.instructions: Steer with arrows or WASD. Pointer and touch dragging move the core directly.

games.title: Coral Current
games.description: Protect a soft light drifting through a current of sharp coral fragments.
games.instructions: Move freely with WASD or arrows, or drag the light. Survive the full current.

games.title: Mintline Rush
games.description: Change lanes through a luminous expressway and reach the distance marker.
games.instructions: Tap a lane or use Left and Right. Avoid rival vehicles and reach the finish distance.

games.title: Circuit Bloom
games.description: Sprint across an electronic garden where traffic blooms in shifting lanes.
games.instructions: Use A/D or arrow keys to switch lanes. Touch the lane you want to enter.

games.title: Nightlane Turbo
games.description: A compact lane racer with quick traffic patterns and three impact shields.
games.instructions: Switch lanes with Left/Right or tap. Reach the goal before your shields are gone.

games.title: Violet Apex
games.description: Chase a high-speed distance target through dense violet circuit traffic.
games.instructions: Use A/D, arrows, or direct lane taps. Collisions cost a shield and momentum.

games.title: Glowtail Garden
games.tagline: Grow a trail of living light.
games.description: Guide a luminous garden snake to dew orbs without crossing its own tail.
games.instructions: Turn with arrows or WASD. Use the touch direction pad on mobile. Gather every dew orb.

games.title: Circuit Serpent
games.description: Build an ever-longer signal serpent across a precision neon grid.
games.instructions: Use arrows or WASD to turn. Never reverse into the signal trail. Collect the target nodes.

games.title: Pebble Trail
games.tagline: A tiny path with a long memory.
games.description: Collect colorful pebbles while keeping a curling trail clear of itself.
games.instructions: Turn with WASD, arrow keys, or the on-screen directions. Fill the collection meter.

games.title: Lunar Loopworm
games.description: A moonlit snake challenge with a fast-growing silver trail.
games.instructions: Use arrows or WASD to steer. Mobile players can use the direction pad. Avoid every wall.

games.title: Neon Brickworks
games.description: Bounce a pulse through a wall of glowing architectural blocks.
games.instructions: Move the paddle with arrows, A/D, or pointer. Press Space or tap to launch the pulse.

games.title: Prism Paddle
games.description: Clear a precise prism mosaic with a responsive light paddle.
games.instructions: Track with pointer or touch, or use Left/Right. Launch with Space or a tap.

games.title: Coral Cascade
games.tagline: Crack a reef of crystal blocks.
games.description: Ricochet a pearl through layered coral glass before your launches run out.
games.instructions: Move with A/D, arrows, or drag. Tap or press Space to send the pearl upward.

games.title: Moonwall Breaker
games.description: A crisp lunar brick breaker with tight angles and limited reserve pulses.
games.instructions: Guide the paddle with arrows or pointer. Press Space or tap to launch after a miss.

games.title: Starloom Patrol
games.description: Pilot a tiny patrol craft and clear a descending formation of signal moths.
games.instructions: Move with arrows or A/D. Fire with Space. Touch and drag the craft; hold to fire.

games.title: Void Petal
games.description: Fire petal pulses through a compact swarm before it reaches the lower field.
games.instructions: Steer with A/D or arrows and shoot with Space. Drag and hold on touch screens.

games.title: Signal Squadron
games.description: Defend a communication lane from waves of corrupted geometric drones.
games.instructions: Move with Left/Right or A/D. Press Space to fire, or drag and hold the arena.

games.title: Orbit Blaster
games.tagline: Push the swarm beyond the rim.
games.description: A brisk single-screen blaster built around clean movement and rapid target reads.
games.instructions: Use arrows or A/D to move and Space to fire. Touch players drag and hold.

games.title: Meteor Mixer
games.tagline: Catch a recipe from the stars.
games.description: Catch bright ingredients and avoid overheated coral comets in a cosmic mixing bowl.
games.instructions: Move the bowl with arrows, A/D, mouse, or touch. Catch the target ingredients.

games.title: Mint Basket
games.description: Slide a woven light basket beneath falling mint fruit and dodge spoiled drops.
games.instructions: Use Left/Right or A/D, or drag the basket. Catch enough good fruit to finish.

games.title: Stardrop Sort
games.tagline: Keep the bright drops. Skip the static.
games.description: Sort a meteor shower by catching luminous stars and avoiding unstable fragments.
games.instructions: Move with arrows or pointer. Good stars add progress; coral fragments cost a shield.

games.title: Cozy Cloud Catch
games.description: Collect soft raindrops while steering clear of tiny crackling storm sparks.
games.instructions: Guide the jar with A/D, arrows, pointer, or touch. Fill it before too many drops escape.

games.title: Glyph Garden
games.description: Turn over geometric garden glyphs and match every pair within the move limit.
games.instructions: Tap cards to reveal them. Keyboard players move with arrows and flip with Space.

games.title: Moonpair Studio
games.description: A tactile memory board of moons, rings, stars, and softly glowing symbols.
games.instructions: Select cards with touch or pointer. Use arrows and Space for keyboard play.

games.title: Signal Match
games.description: Remember and pair a board of compact neon signal marks.
games.instructions: Click or tap two cards. On keyboard, navigate with arrows and reveal with Space.

games.title: Pebble Memory
games.description: Match polished pebble pairs on a calm midnight workbench.
games.instructions: Tap matching tiles, or use arrows plus Space. Complete the board before the move cap.

games.title: Pulse Rally
games.description: Return a quickening pulse against a responsive circuit rival.
games.instructions: Move your paddle with W/S or Up/Down. Pointer and touch track vertically. First to the target wins.

games.title: Neon Volley
games.tagline: A midnight match at light speed.
games.description: A clean neon paddle duel with accelerating rallies and sharp returns.
games.instructions: Use W/S, arrows, pointer, or touch to move. Score the required points first.

games.title: Orbit Pong
games.description: Return a planet-bright ball through a starfield paddle arena.
games.instructions: Move with Up/Down or W/S. Drag vertically on pointer and touch devices.

games.title: Mirror Paddle
games.description: A minimalist paddle duel against an AI that learns the current rally.
games.instructions: Use W/S, arrows, pointer, or touch. Be the first side to claim the match target.

games.title: Lumen Labyrinth
games.tagline: Carry one light to the exit.
games.description: Navigate a freshly generated maze before the lumen timer fades.
games.instructions: Move one cell with arrows or WASD. Touch players use the direction pad. Reach the mint exit.

games.title: Mintway Maze
games.tagline: Trace a path through living walls.
games.description: Find the garden gate in a compact midnight hedge maze.
games.instructions: Navigate with WASD, arrows, or touch directions. Reach the exit before time expires.

games.title: Echo Corridors
games.description: Cross a shifting-feeling geometric maze with only your trail for company.
games.instructions: Use arrows or WASD, or the touch direction pad. Find the far corner in time.

games.title: Prism Pathfinder
games.description: A precision maze run through violet prism walls and luminous intersections.
games.instructions: Move with WASD or arrows. Mobile players use the on-screen directions. Reach the beacon.

games.title: Cloudstep Dash
games.description: Sprint across a cloudline course of blocks, gaps, and floating flux.
games.instructions: Jump with Space, W, Up, or a tap. Reach the distance target with shields remaining.

games.title: Rooftop Relay
games.description: Clear rooftop obstacles in a compact one-button city sprint.
games.instructions: Press Space, W, Up, or tap to jump. Collect relay sparks and avoid coral barriers.

games.title: Coral Cavern Run
games.description: Bound over bright coral hazards on an endless-feeling underwater trail.
games.instructions: Jump with Space, Up, W, or tap. Reach the marked distance before losing every shield.

games.title: Moonlit Bounds
games.description: Float over lunar blocks in a generous but increasingly quick platform sprint.
games.instructions: Jump with Space, W, Up, or touch. Longer timing carries you cleanly over obstacles.

games.title: Beacon Bastion
games.description: Rotate a pulse turret and stop incoming vectors before they touch the beacon.
games.instructions: Aim with pointer or Left/Right. Fire with Space or hold touch. Defeat the full wave.

games.title: Bloom Defense
games.description: Defend a luminous seed core from drifting mechanical thorns.
games.instructions: Aim with arrows or pointer. Press Space or hold the screen to fire petal pulses.

games.title: Signal Keep
games.description: A radial defense challenge against corrupted packets closing on the signal core.
games.instructions: Aim with Left/Right or pointer. Fire with Space or touch. Clear the target count.

games.title: Mintcore Guard
games.description: Protect a mint reactor from fast geometric raiders approaching on every angle.
games.instructions: Turn with arrows or aim directly. Press Space or hold pointer/touch to fire.

games.title: Satellite Swing
games.description: Shift a satellite between three glowing rings to gather nodes and avoid mines.
games.instructions: Use Up/Down or W/S to change rings and Left/Right to adjust orbit. Tap a ring on touch.

games.title: Gravity Garden
games.description: Orbit a soft garden moon and collect seeds across changing gravity rings.
games.instructions: Change orbit with W/S or Up/Down. Touch the ring you want. Avoid coral thorns.

games.title: Orbit Keeper
games.description: Guide a keeper satellite through nodes and hazards on a compact planetary model.
games.instructions: Use arrows or WASD to change ring and orbit speed. Tap directly on a target ring.

games.title: Halo Harvest
games.description: Harvest golden sparks from three orbital halos while dodging unstable fragments.
games.instructions: Switch rings with Up/Down or W/S. Adjust speed with Left/Right. Touch a ring to move.

games.title: Skyline Stack
games.tagline: Build one clean block at a time.
games.description: Drop moving floors onto a midnight tower and trim every imperfect overlap.
games.instructions: Press Space or tap to drop the moving floor. Stack the target height before three misses.

games.title: Tumble Tower
games.description: Time each drop to build a colorful geometric tower without losing the overlap.
games.instructions: Use Space, Enter, click, or tap to place a block. Complete the tower in three misses.

games.title: Mint Balance
games.description: A calm stacking challenge where every off-center placement narrows the next platform.
games.instructions: Drop with Space or tap. Align enough mint platforms to finish the tower.

legacyGames.title: Moonbug Rally
legacyGames.description: Guide a compact moonbug through glowing traffic lanes on a soft-gravity night course.
legacyGames.instructions: Switch lanes with Left/Right or A/D, or tap the lane you want. Reach the finish marker.

legacyGames.title: Tumbletower Trials
legacyGames.description: Stack moving color slabs into a bright precision tower before three placements miss.
legacyGames.instructions: Press Space or click/tap to drop each slab. Complete the target tower.

legacyGames.title: Astro Alley Strikers
legacyGames.tagline: Return the fastest star in town.
legacyGames.description: A quick interstellar paddle match played across a lively alley court.
legacyGames.instructions: Move with W/S or Up/Down. Mouse and touch track vertically. Score the match target first.

legacyGames.title: Hex Garden
legacyGames.tagline: Find a path through quiet geometry.
legacyGames.description: Carry a mint seed through a generated midnight garden maze before its glow fades.
legacyGames.instructions: Navigate with WASD, arrows, or touch directions. Reach the luminous garden gate.

legacyGames.title: Tiny Titan Tactics
legacyGames.description: Aim a pocket-sized titan turret and hold the center against geometric raiders.
legacyGames.instructions: Aim with Left/Right or the mouse. Fire with Space or hold touch. Clear the incoming wave.

legacyGames.title: Marshmallow Mech
legacyGames.description: Pilot a friendly round mech and clear a descending drone formation.
legacyGames.instructions: Move with A/D or arrows and fire with Space. Drag and hold on mouse or touch.

legacyGames.title: Vault of Vines
legacyGames.description: Trace a route through a deep green maze and find the hidden vine vault.
legacyGames.instructions: Use WASD, arrows, or touch directions. Reach the vault before the timer closes.

legacyGames.title: Comet Kitchen
legacyGames.tagline: Catch a recipe from the stars.
legacyGames.description: Catch bright ingredients in a cosmic bowl while avoiding overheated comet fragments.
legacyGames.instructions: Move the bowl with A/D, arrows, mouse, or touch. Fill the recipe meter to win.

legacyGames.title: Shadowboard
legacyGames.description: Run a living shadowboard over luminous blocks and sharp midnight obstacles.
legacyGames.instructions: Jump with Space, W, Up, click, or tap. Reach the distance marker with shields remaining.
